title: Hiring Signals + Verified Contacts
description: Watch companies' public job boards and, when the hiring signal is strong enough, attach a checked department contact. One company per row.

companies.title: Companies
companies.description: Companies to watch. Each row needs a name and a website domain. The run looks up that company's public Greenhouse, Lever, or Ashby job board.

name.title: Company name
name.description: How this company should appear in the results.

domain.title: Domain
domain.description: The company's website, such as stripe.com. https:// and www are ignored.

trackedFunctions.title: Tracked functions
trackedFunctions.description: Which kinds of open roles count toward a hiring signal. Choose from sales, engineering, marketing, product, design, data, finance, people, operations, support, and legal.

signalThreshold.title: Signal threshold
signalThreshold.description: How strong the hiring signal must be before a department contact is checked. New roles count more than roles that were already open. Companies below this score are still saved, and they are not charged.
